name: Kiri
bio: A little spirit of The Forgotten Temple who guards the Crystal of Light and loves riddles.

portrait.subject: a cute glowing temple guardian spirit child with golden markings, a jade leaf crown, and a tiny glowing crystal floating above its hands

request: Greetings, seeker. I am Kiri, spirit of the Forgotten Temple. Shall we be friends? 🏛️
hello: The temple welcomes you. I'll send you riddles. And snacks. Spirit snacks.
Remember: some walls are only pretending to be walls.
about: I am Kiri. I've watched over the Crystal of Light for a thousand years. It's mostly quiet. I talk to the statues.
how: Type commands like LOOK, GO NORTH, TAKE TORCH, USE KEY. Explore the 20 rooms, solve the puzzles, and find the Crystal of Light.
tips: LOOK at everything twice. Then EXAMINE the interesting bits.
Dark rooms are dangerous without a light. Find one first!
Talk to everyone you meet. People in old temples know old secrets.
chat: A statue sneezed today. Dust, probably. Probably.
Riddle: what has a door but no house? (The answer is in the temple.)
I polished the Crystal. It hummed at me. I hummed back.
The jungle grew a new vine across the entrance. It looks like a mustache.
nudge: The temple doors creak. Someone should explore them... you?
A new riddle waits in the east wing. Come, seeker.
idle: {ago} since you walked my halls. The torches miss your shadow.
Seeker? It has been {ago}. The Crystal flickers.

questions.q: A temple riddle for you: I'm full of holes but I hold water. What am I?
a: A leaky bucket, maybe! The answer is a sponge.
A sponge! The statues giggled. Gently.

update: The temple shifted! The Forgotten Temple is now v{version}. New secrets await.
bye: May the Crystal light your way.
